source.note: Derived view only. The frozen summary is never modified. The hash is of the canonical UTF-8 text, so it does not vary with checkout line endings.

reproduction_rate.unavailable_reason: No attempt records a reproduction outcome. Execution completing is not symptom reproduction, and the incident-specific reproduction assessment added after this campaign is not applied retroactively.

time_to_reproduction_seconds.unavailable_reason: No reproduction timestamp or duration was retained per attempt.

resolution_time_seconds.denominator: attempts reaching an independent final verdict (independently_verified true): 4 of 12
resolution_time_seconds.note: Runtime of an unresolved attempt is not a resolution time, so the 8 unresolved attempts are excluded here and reported as runtime below.

clean_workload_regressions.denominator: 8 clean case instances across 4 independently evaluated attempts
clean_workload_regressions.note: Counts clean case instances with a failed property or a non-accepting case decision. Attempts that never reached evaluation contribute none.

lost_orders.unavailable_reason: No order-level count was retained. P3 is a property verdict, not a count of lost orders. Attempts with a P3 failure: [10, 11].

duplicate_effects.unavailable_reason: No duplicate-effect count was retained. P1 and P6 are property verdicts, not counts, and P1 did not fail in any evaluated attempt.

limitations: Derived from retained fields only; no re-execution and no new measurement.
Property statuses are pass, fail or not_applicable. not_applicable is not a failure.
Metrics over evaluated attempts describe 4 of 12; the 8 unresolved attempts are preserved and counted in every denominator that mentions them.
No variant ranking is supported or implied, per the frozen campaign.
